blocks.text: You will find the synonyms of the Valerian eagle in Linn. Syst. T. I. vol. I. p. 254, no. 2, under this name: Falco cera lutea pedibusque semilanatis, corpore e ferrugineo nigricante, striis flavis [falcon with yellow cere and half-woolly feet, body blackish from rust-colour, with yellow streaks]. Other conjectures, but less probable, in my opinion, were put forward by Michaelis in the Supplemm. vol. 5, p. 1880. These too rest on etymologies alone,
